origin.description: Remove code chunks from a noweb file.
origin.details: Lines matching ^<<...>>= start code. A line ^@ returns to documentation. Code lines become empty.
origin.example:
f <- tempfile(fileext=".Rnw")
writeLines(c("Some text", "<<>>=", "code", "@", "more"), f)
cat(paste(SweaveTeXFilter(f), collapse="|"), "\n")

translation.description: Remove code chunks from a noweb file.
translation.details: Lines matching ^<<...>>= start code. A line ^@ returns to documentation. Code lines become empty.
translation.example:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
from tools.sweave import sweave_tex_filter
f = Path(tempfile.mktemp(suffix=".Rnw"))
f.write_text("Some text\n<<>>=\ncode\n@\nmore\n")
print("|".join(sweave_tex_filter(f)))
